scripts.gen: turbo run gen && pnpm run gen:go
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:go && pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run format:check
scripts.lint:go: cd server && go tool -modfile=tools/golangci-lint.mod golangci-lint run
scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm run test:go
scripts.secrets: cd server && go tool -modfile=tools/gitleaks.mod gitleaks git --redact --no-banner ..
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd server && go tool -modfile=tools/golangci-lint.mod golangci-lint fmt
